content: We train all our models for roughly 2 epochs with a batch size of 64. We use a hidden dimension of 150 throughout the model. The embedding layer uses ELMO BIBREF9 which has proven to be very useful in various downstream language understanding tasks. Our FC layers consists of four dense layers with INLINEFORM0 activation after each layer. The dropout rate is kept as 0.2 for every recurrent and FC linear layers. We use Adam optimizer in our experiment with epsilon=1e-8, beta=0.9 and learning rate=1e-3.
